_readme: FIAT EXPEDITIONS (29 Oct): 35 jobs - six far places (688x296, $0.15 each), eighteen hands' faces (128x128), the Bunkhouse's three room-card strips (384x96) and its rail icon (64x64), seven cargo icons (64x64) - $0.08 each but the places. One file a job, straight to its name; the far places and the faces are found by name.
Run the test first: tools/pixellab_expeditions_test_manifest.json. Then this, ++ --parallel 3.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_expeditions_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

jobs.description: Pixel art, wide side-on panorama, far off and still: a wet seafront promenade curving along a wide bay at dusk, the bay flat and grey, a tall hospital block behind the promenade with every window dark, empty railings and lamp posts unlit. Muted blue-grey and slate palette with sparse warm orange lights, low overcast cloud, dusk. Quiet, not busy; no people in the foreground. The subject sits in the middle of the frame (a card crops a small window from the centre), flat even detail side to side, darker at the bottom edge. Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image, not its subject. The painting fills the whole canvas to all four edges, no border, frame or margin. No text, no signs, no lettering, no numbers anywhere.
jobs._where: the far place swansea: the Expeditions card (centre crop) and the Map's far edge
